readingReview.comparison: The first reader's order (title → Dentist → Eye doctor → Paediatrician → Ananya's line → PLAN OF CARE) is the intended 06-1 [1, 2, 3, 4], 06-2 [1, 2]. Each concern was checked. (a) In the placeholder, nobody is shown looking at the planner and its link to the previous scene is unclear. Resolved in the art: the bezel, desk, plant and Ananya's coat-cuffed hand on the trackpad place it in the consultation. (b) The spacing of the tile labels is uneven. Acceptable: each label sits on its own tile drawing, so the pairing is visual and the 6 px gap causes no merging. (c) There is a large blank area between the title and the labels. Resolved: the tile drawings fill it. (d) Ravi gives no verbal reply to 'together'. Acceptable: the line states a plan rather than asking a question, the art shows him smiling and relaxed in agreement, and source PAGE 6 has no reply line. (e) PLAN OF CARE might be read before the balloon. Acceptable: it is 424 px lower and sits over the laptop screen in the foreground as screen content, so the balloon at the top is read first, and the label names the screen section that supports her line. Nothing is unresolved.
